svg.title: Wiring: Level shifter for a 3.3 V MCU, supply always on
svg.desc: Wiring of the WS2812B for the Level shifter for a 3.3 V MCU, supply always on: . Supplies, grounds and the support parts are listed under the drawing.
svg.text: Wiring: Level shifter for a 3.3 V MCU, supply always on
What you connect by hand, with the driver hook on each MCU wire. The full schematic, with every part and value, is on the
Hardware page. Datasheet: Electrical Characteristics, p. 2.
+5V: VDD; also U4.VCC · GND: VSS; also U2.GND, U4.GND
Support parts: 1 capacitor, 2 resistors around the supplies (values in the full schematic). Not wired in this circuit (1): DOUT.
* Not confirmed in the datasheet: U4: general practice: the data sheet draws no level shifter; the HCT input accepts a 3.3 V output; R1: series
resistor next to the first pixel: practice, 300 to 500 ohm; R2: pull-down on the data line: practice; the MCU pin floats from reset until the RMT
